text:
Diego (sales): Heads-up — ThePlant Ltd (UK) asking for invoice reissue without VAT. They supplied VAT GB987654321 and want reverse-charge.
Ola (finance): Ran VIES quick check, GB987654321 returns VALID but company name in VIES is 'THE PLANT LIMITED' (caps/abbr). Can be OK but need supporting docs.
TaxBot: VIES check for GB987654321 124-09-03 09:12 UTC 124-09-03 STATUS: VALID 124-09-03 source: https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies
Aisha (legal): Two things: 1) confirm billing country and whether supply is services or goods (NI protocol edge cases). 2) Ask for HMRC VAT registration letter or Companies House extract to match legal name.
Nina (payments): Please hold on reissue. If we remove VAT and later find the VAT ID doesn't apply, recovery is messy. Flagging: DO NOT ISSUE ZERO-VAT.
Diego (sales): Customer pushed: they sent a PDF HMRC letter and a screenshot of VIES. Attaching: https://files.theplant.example/vat-letter.pdf and https://files.theplant.example/vies_ss.png
Ola (finance): HMRC letter looks like an automated VAT registration confirmation but name is slightly different (Ltd vs Limited). Ask them to confirm trading name vs legal name and provide Companies House extract.
Diego (sales): On it. Asked for Companies House registration extract and the contact who signed the HMRC letter. They're saying "same entity, trading as ThePlant" and want month-end close.
Aisha (legal): Also request the billing address on their invoice to match Companies House address or provide evidence of a UK VAT-able business. For NI customers, if goods are involved, we may need EORI.
Nina (payments): If they need close, offer provisional VAT-charged invoice and credit later when docs come through. But we should avoid making that default.
Diego (sales): Update: customer provided Companies House extract showing "THE PLANT LIMITED" company number 01234567 and a signed HMRC letter. VIES screenshot now shows VALID and name normalized.
TaxBot: Re-checking VIES for GB987654321 124-09-03 13:40 UTC 124-09-03 STATUS: VALID (name: THE PLANT LIMITED).
Ola (finance): Good. Action: Nina, can you reissue invoice net of VAT with reverse-charge wording and attach the HMRC letter + Companies House extract to the billing record? Also save copies to the tax evidence folder.
Nina (payments): Reissue queued. Internal note: "Reverse-charge applied after HMRC letter + Companies House extract received 2024-09-03." I'll attach docs to the invoice.
Aisha (legal): For the record, include text on invoice: "Reverse charge - customer is VAT-registered in the UK (VAT ID GB987654321). Customer liable for VAT under reverse charge".
Ola (finance): Closing loop: invoice reissued net of VAT, evidence uploaded. Diego, mark the subscription record as B2B. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
